_comment: Template for ReYOLOv8 training with HDF5 sequences

_key_flags.use_raw_events: true - Store raw events for representation at training time
_key_flags.clip_mode: sequence - Store entire session as one sequence
_key_flags.event_representation: vtei, voxel_grid, shist, mdes, or ev_temporal_volume
_key_flags.filter_classes: List of class names to filter (e.g. ['person']). Original COCO IDs preserved.
